sender.en: An instant loan app, then “recovery agents” calling and messaging

name.en: Loan app harassment: threats and edited photos sent to your contacts

how.en: An app offers a quick small loan and asks for access to your contacts and photo gallery when you install it. If you are late, recovery agents call and message you and your contacts with threats. Some have used AI to turn borrowers’ photos into fake obscene images and threatened to send them to family unless they pay at once. NCCIA raided a Lahore call centre doing this in October 2026.

text.en: A loan app asks for access to your contacts and gallery.
Recovery agents threaten you and message your contacts.
They threaten to send edited, shameful photos to your family.
They demand immediate payment, often far more than you borrowed.
Aap ki loan payment overdue hai. Aaj 5 baje tak payment na ki to aap ki tasveerein aap ke sab contacts aur family ko bhej di jayengi.
Instant loan Rs 50,000 in 5 minutes, no documents! Just install the app and allow contacts access: [link]

en: loan app sending messages to my contacts
loan app threatening to share my photos
loan app wale family ko message kar rahe hain
loan app asked contacts and gallery permission
Loan apps that want your contacts and gallery.
Threats to shame you in front of family.
Demands to pay far more than agreed.
Use only lenders licensed by the SECP; deny contacts and gallery access.
Don’t pay blackmailers; keep screenshots of threats.
Report to NCCIA on 1799, and warn your contacts.
